craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Assumed-and-shed; everywhere close. Rejected: (a) shed→cast → killed: shed is worn-off. Read aloud: BY-diff-er-ing VI-sions … OWN a-BODE, EV-ery-WHERE.

lines: By differing visions, Lord — shapes assumed and shed —
l4.sanskrit_cite: darśanabhedāt svāminn anyānyām āhṛtiṃ dadhānas tvam bhairavaparabodhamayaṃ prathayasi nijadhāma sarvatra

reads_against.argmap: What abode proclaimed everywhere? → Assumed various, proclaimed waking-made, abode everywhere.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
